mapper.sql: id, user_id, name, status, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM plan WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM plan ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT FROM plan WHERE user_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT task_id FROM plan_task WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, task_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan (user_id, name, status, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{status}, #{scheduledAt}, #{startedAt}, #{finishedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
INSERT INTO plan_task (plan_id, task_id, sort_order, created_at) VALUES (#{planId}, #{taskId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE plan SET name = #{name}, status = #{status}, scheduled_at = #{scheduledAt}, started_at = #{startedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
